x-code-samples.title: Node.js
Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/installation_requests?company_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&developer_app_id=SOME_STRING_VALUE&implicit=SOME_BOOLEAN_VALUE")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

x-code-samples.title: Node.js
Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"company_id\":224087,\"developer_app_id\":\"396e4944-5044-4b72-bb6b-6827d3ab2e75\",\"notes\":\"Requesting installation for use on project XYZ\",\"implicit\":true}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v1.0/installation_requests", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
